motion.purpose: Gentle repeating movement of existing decorative objects.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation: none; transition: none; scroll-behavior: auto

motion.name: invitation-opening
motion.purpose: Card flies upward with 36 mobile or 48 desktop heart particles; the main invitation fades in after the flight. Spatial motion is skipped with reduced motion.

motion.name: opening-hearts
motion.purpose: Sparse burgundy, cream and gold hearts drift behind the opening card; reduced motion disables this.

motion.name: opening-idle
motion.value: 800ms arrival; 6s card float/floral sway; 3.6s heartbeat; 6s button sheen
motion.purpose: Invitation waits with subtle coordinated movement. CSS loops pause in background tabs, stop during flight, and are disabled with reduced motion. Flight starts from the current computed transform.

narrative.overview:
The supplied ui_mau is the visual authority. Burgundy paper, warm cream stock, formal serif lettering, floral cutouts and layered envelope imagery carry the invitation's intimate, ceremonial character.

The implemented system reads vertically on a phone. Cream sections alternate with inset burgundy panels; photographs and paper textures supply material depth. Preserve this established visual world when extending the page.
keyCharacteristics: Warm cream stock and textured burgundy paper.
Formal serif names with script ampersands.
Centered invitation content and narrow, readable forms.
Layered floral, envelope and photographic assets from ui_mau.

rules.name: The Paper Contrast Rule
rules.body: Keep light lettering on burgundy panels and burgundy lettering on cream insets.

rules.name: The Script Accent Rule
rules.body: Use The Nautigal for the existing ampersand accents; retain serif typography for readable content and controls.

dos: Do preserve ui_mau's paper textures, floral assets, envelope composition and established palette.
Do keep the calendar inset and guestbook form/cards light against the surrounding paper.
Do retain readable serif form text, visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't replace the supplied visual world with a new aesthetic or a generic dashboard layout.
Don't flatten the envelope and photographic layers into unrelated decorative cards.
Don't extend script typography into body copy or form controls.
